name: Cass Flow
intro: [angry] Stop right there. This is a closed set.
Wait. You? We dropped you. Down a hole. On the surface.
[sad] You were the best sound engineer the tour ever had. Then you read the plans.
[angry] It doesn’t matter. The press is nearly done, and you’re not on the guest list.
lines: “Nothing personal. It’s just the bottom line.”
win: “Fine. Go up the Spire, then. She’ll be delighted. She loves a comeback.”
hint: Cass Flow waits at the pressing plant with a team around level 55–57.
